latest.d: Tesla’s planned Won1.1tn investment is included in Samsung Electro-Mechanics’ Won4.27tn capital expenditure programme to expand FC-BGA manufacturing facilities.

stories.summary: Samsung Electro-Mechanics will expand FC-BGA substrate manufacturing under a Won4.27tn capex programme that includes a planned Won1.1tn Tesla investment. Nvidia also backs the expansion.
